task: t37 — seeded negative-control lane for the T-19 pin (re-dispatch of the cancelled t36)
why: the reddening proof for the requalified T-19 pin existed only in a MESSAGE; this wave established that a reading whose only home is a message is rotted-in-waiting, and that every claim should ship an instrument with a NEGATIVE CONTROL that reddens on revert. This lane is that instrument: it SEEDS the wave-1 two-peer wording into a scratch copy of the module and asserts that the pin's own matchers go RED there.

change.shape: ADDITIVE tail lane (85 lines / 6,108 bytes) + no helper outside the file

additive_only_proof.method: cut the file at the lane's header marker and hash everything before it (the lane was appended as `rstrip + lane`), so the shipped assertions and the five-state coverage are shown byte-identical to the revision t32 reviewed rather than promised unchanged

seeded_lane_readings.seed: the TRUE wave-1 line (condition `team.halted`, NOT the new `team.pause.active`) restored verbatim into a scratch copy of `lib/`, matched by a backtick regex with a ONE-OCCURRENCE assert before the replace (and a post-replace assert that the seeded text is present)
seeded_lane_readings.scratch_copy_derivation: `mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), 'mpd-t19-seed-'))` -> `cpSync(libDir, scratch/lib)` -> `symlinkSync(<plugin>/_deps, scratch/_deps)`; the copy lives OUTSIDE the workspace (T-89: a copy under the repo is discoverable by a substring-filtered `bun test`) and is deleted in `finally`
seeded_lane_readings.driver: the copy's own `registerAgentTeamsTools` with the same ctx shape the pins use and a LIVE watchdog stub (`isHeld` -> HOLD_VIEW), then `agent_teams_status` render

old_wording.diagnostic_falsehood_reproduced: the seeded copy renders `Pause: agent-teams halt not active` WHILE the team is HELD (the defect the collapse fixed), and contains `· team watchdog hold: not read on this surface`

shipped_wording.why_this_leg_matters: the shipped module is driven through the same four predicates in the same test, so the lane cannot pass by the pin having drifted away from the strings the lane asserts

seeded_lane_readings.revert_behaviour: reverting the fix in the shipped module makes the lane redden at the SEED step itself (the shipped-line regex would no longer occur exactly once), so the lane is falsifiable in both directions

measurement_correction_disclosed.what_i_said_before: in the message-level seeding I reported the prefix leg as reading TRUE on the restored old wording
measurement_correction_disclosed.what_was_wrong: that seeded line was a HYBRID — the OLD tail with the NEW condition (`team.pause.active`), so it rendered ACTIVE because the hold was live; the true wave-1 line keys on `team.halted` and therefore renders `not active`
measurement_correction_disclosed.effect_on_the_conclusion: none for the three drift-guard matchers (they are independent of the ACTIVE/not-active half) — the drift guards did and do read false; the prefix leg is restated in the lane and in this file: both wordings SHARE the `Pause: agent-teams halt ` prefix, which is exactly why the pin needs more than a prefix assertion
